svg.title: Which observations carry over from human demonstrations to the robot?

g.text: Which observations carry over from human demonstrations to the robot?

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Human-only policies in a digital twin of the basket task, 30 rollouts each. No RGB variant finished the task, and view-aligned RGB never

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: reached the basket. Point clouds always reached it; replacing the human hand with robot-hand points gave the most grasps and successes.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: Simulation: MuJoCo digital twin of the RB-Y1 basket task (Chuye Zhang's). Stages are cumulative from the same rollouts. View alignment re-renders the human

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #5c5c5c

g.text: view from the robot camera height (EgoHumanoid-style 2D to 3D to 2D reprojection with inpainting), with a ResNet-18 image encoder.
